title: Imperfect middle/passive
subtitle: Recognize past forms ending in -μην, -το, and -ντο.
overview: The imperfect middle/passive combines augment, present stem, and secondary middle/passive endings.
As with present forms, context determines whether the form is middle, passive, or lexically middle.

sections.title: ἐλυόμην: core endings
rows: he or she was being loosed
we were / they were being loosed

items.en: They were going into the city.
